source_issue.title: PLIP: Start separating Classic UI code from the core

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on improving Plone by gradually separating Classic UI code from the core `Products.CMFPlone` package. This aims to create cleaner, more maintainable code and reduce the size of the backend for users who don't use the Classic UI.

## What needs to be done
We need to move Classic UI templates and related logic into a new `plone.app.layout` package, while ensuring existing functionality isn't broken. A subpackage, `plone.classicui`, will also be created to manage the Classic UI.

## Helpful background
The proposal aims to keep some Classic UI features in the core but offloads UI-related code to `plone.app.layout`, especially important for future compatibility with headless setups (like Volto). Discussions in the comments reveal mixed feelings on implementation details and package naming conventions, indicating there may be some ambiguity.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with the current codebase, especially `Products.CMFPlone` and `plone.app.layout`.
2. Consider reviewing existing templates and logic that may need to move.
3. Join discussions to clarify uncertain points about package structure and naming, particularly in the context of upcoming Plone releases.
4. Help create or revise documentation as changes progress.
5. Testing and coordination with other contributors will be essential to ensure compatibility.
```
